title: 6.3. WT_STOP_SENDING Capsule
content:
An HTTP capsule \[[HTTP-DATAGRAM](https://www.ietf.org/archive/id/draft-ietf-webtrans-http2-15.html#HTTP-DATAGRAM)\] called [WT\_STOP\_SENDING](https://www.ietf.org/archive/id/draft-ietf-webtrans-http2-15.html#WT_STOP_SENDING) (type=0x190B4D3A) is introduced to communicate that incoming data is being discarded on receipt per application request. [WT\_STOP\_SENDING](https://www.ietf.org/archive/id/draft-ietf-webtrans-http2-15.html#WT_STOP_SENDING) requests that a peer cease transmission on a WebTransport stream.[¶](https://www.ietf.org/archive/id/draft-ietf-webtrans-http2-15.html#section-6.3-1)

WT_STOP_SENDING Capsule {
  Type (i) = 0x190B4D3A,
  Length (i),
  Stream ID (i),
  Application Protocol Error Code (i),
}

[Figure 4](https://www.ietf.org/archive/id/draft-ietf-webtrans-http2-15.html#figure-4): [WT\_STOP\_SENDING Capsule Format](https://www.ietf.org/archive/id/draft-ietf-webtrans-http2-15.html#name-wt_stop_sending-capsule-for) 

The [WT\_STOP\_SENDING](https://www.ietf.org/archive/id/draft-ietf-webtrans-http2-15.html#WT_STOP_SENDING) capsule defines the following fields:[¶](https://www.ietf.org/archive/id/draft-ietf-webtrans-http2-15.html#section-6.3-3)

Stream ID:

A variable-length integer carrying the WebTransport stream ID of the stream being ignored.[¶](https://www.ietf.org/archive/id/draft-ietf-webtrans-http2-15.html#section-6.3-4.2.1)

Application Protocol Error Code:

A variable-length integer containing the application-specified reason the sender is ignoring the stream. WebTransport application error codes are constrained to an unsigned 32-bit range defined in [Section 4.4](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-webtrans-http3-15#section-4.4) of \[[WEBTRANSPORT-H3](https://www.ietf.org/archive/id/draft-ietf-webtrans-http2-15.html#WEBTRANSPORT-H3)\]. This value MUST NOT exceed 0xffffffff, values larger than this MUST be treated as a session error of type WT\_ERROR.[¶](https://www.ietf.org/archive/id/draft-ietf-webtrans-http2-15.html#section-6.3-4.4.1)

As defined in [Section 3.5](https://rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9000#section-3.5) of \[[RFC9000](https://www.ietf.org/archive/id/draft-ietf-webtrans-http2-15.html#RFC9000)\], the recipient of a [WT\_STOP\_SENDING](https://www.ietf.org/archive/id/draft-ietf-webtrans-http2-15.html#WT_STOP_SENDING) capsule sends a [WT\_RESET\_STREAM](https://www.ietf.org/archive/id/draft-ietf-webtrans-http2-15.html#WT_RESET_STREAM) capsule in response if the stream is in the "Ready" or "Send" state. The error code from the [WT\_STOP\_SENDING](https://www.ietf.org/archive/id/draft-ietf-webtrans-http2-15.html#WT_STOP_SENDING) capsule can be copied into the [WT\_RESET\_STREAM](https://www.ietf.org/archive/id/draft-ietf-webtrans-http2-15.html#WT_RESET_STREAM) capsule if the endpoint does not have a more appropriate code to use.[¶](https://www.ietf.org/archive/id/draft-ietf-webtrans-http2-15.html#section-6.3-5)

A [WT\_STOP\_SENDING](https://www.ietf.org/archive/id/draft-ietf-webtrans-http2-15.html#WT_STOP_SENDING) capsule MUST NOT be sent multiple times for the same stream. While QUIC permits redundant STOP\_SENDING frames, the ordering guarantee in HTTP/2 makes this unnecessary. A [stream error](https://www.ietf.org/archive/id/draft-ietf-webtrans-http2-15.html#errors) ([Section 3.4](https://www.ietf.org/archive/id/draft-ietf-webtrans-http2-15.html#errors)) of type WT\_STREAM\_STATE\_ERROR MUST be sent if a second [WT\_STOP\_SENDING](https://www.ietf.org/archive/id/draft-ietf-webtrans-http2-15.html#WT_STOP_SENDING) capsule is received.[¶](https://www.ietf.org/archive/id/draft-ietf-webtrans-http2-15.html#section-6.3-6)
